invariants.rationale: writeClient is dereferenced to invoke bulkInsertPreppedRecords and commit.
instantTime is passed to methods and likely cannot be null.
preppedRecordInputs is passed to writeClient.bulkInsertPreppedRecords and must not be null.
bulkInsertPartitioner is passed into the method and used, so it must not be null (Option may be empty but not null).
preppedRecordInputs should be a valid list, either empty or with non-negative size.
